context: Mei reads bedtime poem to small Hina (use hina_child as toddler).
purpose: Mother sharing poetry with young child at night.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Hina, I'm going to read you a poem tonight.
lines.style: Soft, unhurried opening. Warm and luminous tone—the kind of voice you use when you're about to share something precious. Slight lean-in. No performance, just presence.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Sleepy delight. Small and genuine—not performing excitement but feeling it. Nestled into the moment. Warm exhale on the hum.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Conversational, inviting. Soft cadence like she's thinking out loud with Hina. Wondering together, not instructing. Gentle rhythm, almost musical.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: It touches your heart, doesn't it.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Hina discovering something true. Small voice but steady. The tone of someone who has just felt something move through them.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Soft, sustaining warmth. The words settle like a blanket. No rush. A held pause before releasing her to sleep. Deep care in the gentleness.
